Description: The run script uses the model default of 100 creator agents.
Every even-indexed creator is initialized as new; with 100 creators this produces 50 new creators.
Every odd-indexed creator is initialized as established; with 100 creators this produces 50 established creators.
Each new creator's initial popularity is drawn uniformly from [0.05, 0.20] using the model's seeded random generator.
Each established creator's initial popularity is drawn uniformly from [0.70, 1.00] using the model's seeded random generator.
Creator topics are assigned cyclically across the five topics. With 100 creators, each topic has 20 creators: 10 new and 10 established.
Each creator's total_impressions counter starts at zero.
Each creator's total_engagements counter starts at zero.
The run script uses the model default of 200 viewer agents.
Viewer primary topics are assigned cyclically across the five topics.
With 200 viewers assigned cyclically across five topics, each topic has 40 viewers.

Value: One static primary topic per viewer
Description: Each viewer has one preferred_topic; the preference is not updated during the simulation.
One viewer is selected randomly from the viewer agents each round; selection is with replacement, so a viewer may be selected again in later rounds.
All creator agents are scored as candidates in each round.
The highest-scoring 10 creators are selected for the recommendation slate in each round.
run.py executes 50 model steps for each primary run and each robustness-sweep run.
Creator popularity and viewer interest are combined using the condition-specific popularity weight.
Status / Notes: Simplified model rule; not YouTube's proprietary ranking algorithm

Description: run.py sets weight=0.10; popularity contributes 10% and viewer interest contributes 90%.
run.py sets weight=0.90; popularity contributes 90% and viewer interest contributes 10%.
For each creator candidate whose topic matches the active viewer, interest is drawn uniformly from [0.65, 1.00].

Parameter: Interest score when topics do not match
Description: For each creator candidate whose topic does not match the active viewer, interest is drawn uniformly from [0.00, 0.35].
Each recommended creator with a topic matching the active viewer's preference has a 0.65 probability of engagement.

Parameter: Engagement probability when topics do not match
Description: Each recommended creator with a topic not matching the active viewer's preference has a 0.10 probability of engagement.
A creator that receives engagement gains 0.03 popularity during its update for that round.
For an engaged creator, the +0.03 gain is applied first and capped at 1.00; then the -0.002 decay is applied. Creators without engagement still receive the decay.
Every creator loses 0.002 popularity on every round, whether or not it was recommended or engaged.
After the decay is applied, popularity is floored at 0.01.
The engagement gain is capped at 1.00 before the round's decay is applied; therefore 1.00 is not necessarily the end-of-round maximum.
run.py uses seed=42 for both the baseline and alternative primary comparison runs.
run.py runs both conditions once for each seed from 0 through 19, producing 20 runs per condition (40 runs total).
